title: Delaying Post-Quantum Crypto Pilots Could Raise Costs 200%: Gartner
key_facts: Gartner: delaying PQC pilots beyond 2027 could mean at least 200% higher migration costs
51% of CISOs surveyed had not begun PQC work
Part of Gartner's Q4 2026 cybersecurity priorities
Threats named: harvest now, decrypt later; harvest now, forge later
One of five recommended actions for CISOs
quote_evidence: Organisations that delay piloting post-quantum cryptography (PQC) until after 2027 could face at least 200 per cent higher costs for full migration, Gartner said
51 per cent of chief information security officers (CISOs) surveyed by Gartner said their organisations had not yet begun any PQC-related activities
why_it_matters_hint: Cost of delay for quantum-safe encryption.
notes: Survey date not stated for the PQC finding.
